objective: Make Tier-2 real: implement GET /breakdown/{diff_id} in server/app.py so the card's 'open details' tap answers WHY, not 'Breakdown unavailable'. Today grep -n breakdown server/*.py returns nothing -- the route specified at contracts/openapi.yaml:129 has never existed, _diff_id() hashes a calculation that is then discarded, and every driver a tester has seen came from web/mock/fixtures/breakdown/*.json. The contract is already ratified, so this is an implementation, not a contract change. (1) At /diff time, store the diff under the diff_id you already return: item_text, selected preset, applied overrides, and the engine calculation payload. In-memory, bounded at 64 entries, oldest evicted first; unknown or evicted id => 404 exactly as the contract says. (2) Compute drivers by LEAVE-ONE-OUT attribution against the real engine: for each explicit modifier line on the candidate item, re-run calculator.diff() on the item with that one line removed; the movement in the card's offense delta (stat total_dps) and defense delta (stat ehp) IS that mod's contribution_pct. One driver per (mod, stat) with a non-zero contribution, sorted by descending |contribution_pct|. These are real measurements of this player's item against this player's build. (3) They do NOT sum to 100 -- mods interact -- so document the definition in server/README.md and emit nothing that implies a normalized share. (4) I5 governs every uncertain case: a mod whose leave-one-out run the engine rejects is simply absent from drivers, never estimated; if nothing is attributable, drivers is []; the server never reads a mock fixture. (5) Tier-3 stays honest too: do NOT emit pob_breakdown -- engine/pobcalc.lua's "pob://calcs/<slot>" is a calculation slot id, not a breakdown tree. Narrow the engine/GAPS.md open bullet to the Tier-3 raw tree and record Tier-2 as landed.
constraints: No contract change. GET /breakdown/{diff_id} is implemented exactly as contracts/openapi.yaml already specifies it; if you believe the Breakdown schema is wrong, stop and route it to pm -- do not edit contracts/.
The diff store is in-memory, bounded (64 entries, oldest evicted first), and holds nothing a diff response did not already contain. No disk, no database, no background expiry thread.

Every number in drivers comes from an engine run made for THIS diff. No heuristic weighting, no mod-text pattern table, no reading web/mock/** -- a fabricated contribution is a confidently wrong answer and worse than an empty list (I5).

Attribution is a Tier-2 tap, not the clipboard->verdict path, so I6's 300 ms budget does not bind it; it must still reuse the warm worker and issue at most one engine diff per attributable mod line (the base numbers come from the stored calculation, not a re-run).
Do not emit pob_breakdown. Shipping the breakdown_ref placeholder as a Tier-3 tree would be the exact dishonesty engine/GAPS.md exists to prevent.

Existing tests may be EXTENDED, never deleted or skipped; engine/tests/fixtures/item.txt stays byte-identical, and the runtime-availability skips must keep skipping LOUDLY -- a missing runtime never silently passes.
Stage PR uses 'Refs #125', never 'Fixes' (ADR-0008): #125's frontend stage is TASK-214-S2.

acceptance_criteria.text: GET /breakdown/{diff_id} with an id returned by an immediately preceding POST /diff returns 200 and a body that validates against the Breakdown schema in contracts/openapi.yaml, with diff_id echoed unchanged.
An unknown diff_id returns 404 with no invented body; a diff_id evicted by the 64-entry bound also returns 404 (tested by driving 65 distinct diffs and re-requesting the first).

A test proves each contribution_pct is a real measurement: for the top driver, re-running POST /diff on the same item with that one mod line removed moves the card's delta for that driver's stat by the reported contribution (within a stated numeric tolerance).

A test proves the honest-empty path: when no mod line is attributable the response is drivers: [], and a mod whose leave-one-out run raises ItemParseError or WorkerUnavailable is absent from drivers rather than estimated.
grep proves server/ reads no file under web/mock/ and contains no hardcoded driver text; the endpoint's only data sources are the stored diff and the engine.
The response omits pob_breakdown entirely, and engine/GAPS.md's 'Breakdown references are placeholders' bullet is narrowed to the Tier-3 raw tree with Tier-2 drivers recorded as landed.
server/README.md documents the leave-one-out definition of contribution_pct and states explicitly that drivers do not sum to 100 because mods interact.
All three required checks pass and no test was deleted or skipped.

rollback: git revert the stage commit; /breakdown returns to not existing and the details panel returns to its honest 'Breakdown unavailable' error state. No other endpoint changes behavior.
